plan.name: Retry incomplete local library migrations
plan.summary: Change only migrateLocalLibrary in lib/history.ts so it sets the migrated flag and deletes the old database only after every local item has been uploaded successfully or is already shared under the same kind and name. Opening errors, metadata or byte read failures (including missing bytes and synchronous IndexedDB exceptions), shared-list failures and upload failures must leave the flag unset and the local database intact, close any opened connection and allow the next call to retry. Preserve oldest-first uploads with their metadata and bytes, skip already-shared items without reading their blobs, and use the shared list on retry to avoid uploading successful items again. Preserve the upgrade-needed path that aborts database creation and marks migration complete without uploading or deleting, and the no-op behavior for unreadable localStorage or an existing migration flag. Add regression coverage for shared-list failures, empty and already-shared libraries, and those preserved no-op paths; no other history exports or documentation need changes.

tests.name: Retry opening the old library
tests.says: An open request error leaves the migration pending and the old library intact; a later call uploads missing items in order, recognizes matches by both kind and name, preserves bytes and metadata, and completes.
tests.selector: local library migration retries an open error and completes only after the items are shared

tests.name: Retry a metadata request error
tests.says: A failed metadata request is not an empty library: it retains the database without a completion flag and retries successfully on the next call.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries metadata after request error

tests.name: Retry a metadata transaction exception
tests.says: A synchronous exception opening the metadata transaction retains the database without a completion flag and permits a later successful migration.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries metadata after transaction exception

tests.name: Retry a metadata read exception
tests.says: A synchronous exception issuing the metadata read retains the database without a completion flag and permits a later successful migration.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries metadata after read exception

tests.name: Keep an item whose bytes are missing
tests.says: A missing blob for an item not yet shared prevents completion and deletion, even if another item uploaded; a later call retries the missing item without re-uploading successful items.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries an unreadable item after missing bytes

tests.name: Retry a blob request error
tests.says: A blob request error leaves the whole local library intact and migration pending; a later call completes without repeating successful uploads.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries an unreadable item after request error

tests.name: Retry a blob transaction exception
tests.says: A synchronous exception opening a blob transaction prevents completion and deletion, and a later call retries the missing item.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries an unreadable item after transaction exception

tests.name: Retry a blob read exception
tests.says: A synchronous exception issuing a blob read prevents completion and deletion, and a later call retries without re-uploading items already shared.
tests.selector: local library migration preserves and retries an unreadable item after read exception

tests.name: Retry a rejected upload response
tests.says: An unsuccessful upload response leaves migration pending and local items intact; the next call uploads only the unshared item and then completes.
tests.selector: local library migration retries only the unshared item after HTTP error

tests.name: Retry a rejected upload promise
tests.says: A rejected upload fetch leaves migration pending and local items intact; the next call uploads only the unshared item and then completes.
tests.selector: local library migration retries only the unshared item after network rejection

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and 10 acceptance tests covering migration failures and successful retries, leaving `repo/` unchanged. The plan check passed: all acceptance tests fail as required on the base, while lint, typecheck, and 82 existing tests pass.
